notes.title: Update 1.04 out: New levels and motion-sickness-proof controls
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We just released a content and feature update for you all!  Here's what you get:

-Three new levels!  Diamondback, Trace, and Bounce.

-Motion-sickness-proof controls!  While many people have enjoyed the game in first person, the fact is first person locomotion makes many people feel sick.  "Normal" teleportation wouldn't work for this game, since you could skip past traps.  So we built a 3rd person mode - you exist in the levels with an avatar that you move around.  You can then press a button (which button depends on your control scheme) and your camera will teleport behind your avatar.  So you can't skip past traps, but you still don't have any artificial camera movement beyond the instant teleportation, so we hope that's a great fit for this game.  You can steer your avatar with typical gamepad controls, or you can direct the character by aiming your Vive controllers.  We hope that folks seeking a perfectly comfortable experience will now try out our game!  This mode can be enabled from the settings screen in the main menu, or by typing "settings third_person 1" at any time in-game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25817687/bd4575213449ea9e4f151e86ccaee15e5aa150d3.png[/img]

Enjoy!
-Team Future

notes.title: Bugfix Update Released
notes.notes:
Apologies for the rocky start some folks had, but we just pushed out an update for those of you who were crashing when trying to start the game from the main menu.  Seemed to be caused by using Vive while having an XBox controller connected, how odd!  We hope you can all get into the game and enjoy now!  Contact us with any other issues you find.

Also, we fixed some of our app's flags - it now properly appears in your "VR" games list and can be launched from SteamVR.

Have fun!
